caption: The drawing depicts a wooden bench with a simple, geometric design. The bench is shown in a three-quarters view, revealing both the front and side panels. It consists of four main vertical supports at each end and at angles beneath the seat, with all visible surfaces painted in a muted blue color, showing wood grain and texture. The edges of the bench are outlined in a contrasting, natural wood color. Each end panel is rounded at the top and features a circular cutout. The legs on each end are split at the base, creating two points in contact with the ground per side. The seat is flat, while the supporting side panels are set diagonally, reinforcing the structure. The composition is centered on a plain, light background, with a thin, single-line border enclosing the drawing. In the lower right corner, "VINCENT A ROESL -390-1 DEL" is inscribed in red text.
title: Wagon Bench
